```{python}
# prepare Data 
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df_raw=pd.read_csv("Data/Project.csv", sep=';', decimal=',')

df=df_raw.copy()
df1 = df[df["Provinsi"] != "Indonesia"]
df2 = df1[df1["Year"] != 2020]

year_colors = {
    2021: "green",
    2022: "orange",
    2023: "red"
}

indo_readingfreq = df2["Reading Frequency per week"].mean().astype('int')
indo_internetaccess = df2["Internet Access Frequency per Week"].mean().astype('int')
```

# Reading Interest

## Row {height="300%"}

### Column {width="100%"}
```{python}
#| title: Reading Interest in Indonesian Provinces (2021–2023)
#| fig-width: 20
#| fig-height: 8
#| layout-ncol: 1
rein=sns.relplot(data=df2, 
    x="Provinsi", 
    y="Tingkat Kegemaran Membaca (Reading Interest)", 
    hue="Year", 
    palette=year_colors,
    height=6, 
    aspect=5)

rein.set_axis_labels(
    "Province",                      # X axis
    "Reading Interest Score (%)"     # Y axis
)

for ax in rein.axes.flat:
    ax.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

```

## Row {height="100%"}

### Column {width="16%"}

```{python}
#| title: Sumatra
#| fig-width: 20
#| fig-height: 8
#| layout-ncol: 1
df_sumatra = df2[df2['Provinsi'].isin([
    'Aceh', 'Bangka Belitung Islands', 'Jambi', 'Lampung',
    'North Sumatra', 'Riau', 'Riau Islands',
    'South Sumatra', 'West Sumatra', 'Bengkulu'
])]

g = sns.relplot(
    data=df_sumatra,
    x='Year',
    y='Tingkat Kegemaran Membaca (Reading Interest)',
    kind='line',
    hue='Provinsi',
    height=6,
    aspect=1.8
)
g.set_axis_labels("Year", "Reading Interest Score (%)")

for ax in g.axes.flat:
    ax.set_xticks([2021, 2022, 2023])
    ax.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
```

# Activity Frequency

## Row {height="100%"}

### Column {width="100%"}

```{python}
#| title: Reading Frequency per Week in 2021-2023
#| fig-width: 20
#| fig-height: 8
#| layout-ncol: 1
rf=sns.catplot(data = df2, 
    x="Provinsi",
    y="Reading Frequency per week", 
    kind="box",
    height=2.8,
    aspect=8)

rf.set_axis_labels("Province", "Reading Frequency", fontsize=8)

for ax in rf.axes.flat:
    ax.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
```

# Relational Data

## Row {height="200%"}

### Column {width="50%"}

```{python}
#| title: Relation Between Internet Access Frequency and Reading Interest
#| fig-width: 20
#| fig-height: 8
#| layout-ncol: 1
m= sns.relplot(data=df2, 
    x="Internet Access Frequency per Week", 
    y="Tingkat Kegemaran Membaca (Reading Interest)", 
    hue="Year",
    palette=year_colors,
    height=5, 
    aspect=1.5)

m.set_axis_labels("Internet Access Frequency per Week", "Reading Interest")
```

### Column {width="50%"}

```{python}
#| title: Relation Between Daily Internet Duration and Daily Reading Duration

    palette=year_colors,

    hue="Year",
    height=5, 
    aspect=1.5)
```
